title: Social Media Content Creator & VA
description:
Rate: $5 USD/hour

Hours: 40 hours/week

Schedule: Primarily 9:00 AM-5:00 PM EST (with some flexibility)



We’re looking for someone who is obsessed with social media.



The type of person who scrolls Instagram or TikTok and immediately thinks:

“I know why that video went viral.”



Someone who studies hooks, understands audience psychology, notices editing trends before everyone else, and gets excited about creating content that actually converts into sales.



If that sounds like you, keep reading.



About the Role



We’re looking for a full-time Social Media Content Creator & Video Editor to become a key part of our growing real estate media company.

This role is primarily focused on content strategy and video editing, with occasional virtual assistant tasks to support the business.

We’re not looking for someone to simply schedule posts or follow generic growth advice.

We’re looking for someone who can bring ideas to the table, help shape our content strategy, and create engaging content that people actually want to watch.

If you love creating content, editing videos, staying on top of trends, and want a long-term opportunity with a supportive team, we’d love to meet you.



What You’ll Be Doing



Content Creation & Editing

* Edit engaging short-form videos for Instagram, TikTok,
, and YouTube

* Create dynamic edits using captions, motion graphics, and 3D text

* Research current social media trends and viral content

* Develop content ideas that drive engagement and generate leads

* Write hooks, captions, scripts, and content concepts

* Analyze competitors and industry leaders for inspiration

* Help build and improve our overall content strategy

* Recommend new ideas based on performance and trends



Virtual Assistant Support

* Organize files and digital assets

* Assist with administrative tasks as needed

* Help keep projects organized and moving forward



What We’re Looking For



Required Skills

* Strong video editing experience

* Experience creating content for Instagram, TikTok,
, or YouTube

* Advanced editing skills (captions, motion graphics, 3D text, transitions, pacing)

* Strong understanding of social media trends and audience engagement

* Excellent written English

* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Comfortable working independently and taking initiative



Bonus Points If You Have

* Experience growing social media accounts

* Experience creating content that drives leads or sales

* Graphic design experience

* Experience in the real estate or marketing industry



The Type of Person Who Thrives Here

* Creative and full of ideas

* Studies successful content for fun

* Self-motivated and proactive

* Loves learning and improving

* Comfortable giving recommendations and sharing opinions

* Reliable and looking for a long-term opportunity

* Wants to grow with a supportive team



Why You’ll Love This Role

* Full-time, stable position

* Flexible and supportive work environment

* Lots of creative freedom and input

* Opportunity to help shape a growing brand

* Long-term growth potential

* A team that values ideas and initiative, not just task completion



To Apply



Please include ALL of the following with your application (applications missing these items will not be considered):



1. A 1-minute video introduction telling us about yourself and your experience.

2. Links to social media accounts you’ve managed or created content for.

3. Your editing portfolio (Google Drive, Behance, Vimeo, etc.).

4. Your updated resume.

title: Social Media Content Editor (Instagram Reels/TikTok)
description:
Schedule: Monday-Friday availability preferred

Hours: Approximately 10-12 hours per week to start (2 hours/day, 5-6 days/week)

Some overlap with Eastern Time business hours preferred for communication and collaboration

Remote Position



We are hiring a highly creative, detail-oriented, and coachable Short-Form Video Editor & Social Media Assistant to join our growing real estate media company serving the DMV area.



This is not just an editing role. We are looking for someone who genuinely understands modern short-form content and wants to help grow visibility, engagement, relationships, and overall business opportunities through social media.



You will help create engaging reels and short-form content for real estate agents, listings, behind-the-scenes media, and agent-focused branding across Instagram Reels, TikTok,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



This role starts focused primarily on content creation and editing, but there is strong long-term growth potential for the right person to eventually take on broader social media management responsibilities as the company continues to grow.



If you naturally pay attention to social media trends, understand what makes people stop scrolling, and enjoy helping brands grow online, this may be a great fit for you.



What You’ll Do

• Edit short-form vertical video content optimized for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Create engaging, retention-focused edits using strong hooks, pacing, captions, trending audio, and modern editing styles

• Assist with content posting and optimization across multiple platforms

• Maintain organization and consistency across content workflows

• Double-check captions, formatting, audio, exports, thumbnails, and post quality before publishing

• Track engagement trends and key performance metrics over time

• Monitor retention, reach, saves, shares, comments, and overall content performance

• Help identify which content styles and topics are performing best

• Assist with collaboration ideas involving agents, affiliates, and local businesses

• Bring proactive content and growth suggestions to the table instead of simply posting passively

• Help increase overall brand visibility through stronger video distribution and social engagement strategies



Compensation & Growth Path

• Starting pay: $4-$6/hour depending on experience and skill level

• Part-time role to start (approximately 10-12 hours per week)

• Opportunity for increased hours and compensation as responsibilities grow

• Long-term potential to expand into broader social media management and content strategy responsibilities

• Opportunity to grow with a fast-moving real estate media company focused heavily on video and brand expansion



What We’re Looking For

• Strong CapCut editing experience highly preferred

• Strong understanding of short-form content pacing, hooks, captions, and retention-focused editing

• Actively understands and consumes Instagram Reels, TikTok, and modern social content trends

• Extremely detail-oriented and organized

• Reliable and consistent with deadlines

• Strong communication skills

• Positive attitude and coachable mindset

• Creative thinker who takes initiative

• Comfortable receiving feedback and implementing revisions quickly

• Ability to work independently while staying communicative

• Canva experience is a plus for simple graphics and carousels

• Real estate media experience is a plus, but not required



This Role May NOT Be For You If:

• You dislike fast-moving environments

• You struggle with consistency or meeting deadlines

• You prefer minimal communication or collaboration

• You only want to “edit videos” without thinking strategically about engagement and growth

• You dislike feedback or revisions

• You tend to rush through details like captions, formatting, or audio quality



Why This Role Is Great

• Flexible remote schedule

• Clear long-term growth potential

• Opportunity to help shape a growing media brand

• Creative and collaborative work environment

• Chance to build valuable social media strategy experience

• Opportunity to work closely with real estate professionals and growing businesses

• Consistent opportunity to improve editing, branding, and content strategy skills



Application Instructions

When applying, please include:

• Your resume

• A short intro video introducing yourself

• Your portfolio or examples of short-form content/reels you have edited

• A brief explanation of why you think your best-performing videos performed well

• Your favorite social media platform and why

• Your experience using CapCut and/or Canva

• Any experience you have with social media analytics, engagement tracking, or content strategy



We are looking for someone who genuinely cares about creating quality content and helping brands grow — not someone who simply uploads videos.



If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Real Estate Media Virtual Assistant (Photo QC + Media Delivery) | Photoshop / Lightroom
description:
Job Description



We are looking for a detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help with quality control and delivery of real estate media.



This role is primarily responsible for reviewing real estate photos and videos before they are delivered to clients to ensure everything looks correct, complete, and professional.



You will review large batches of photos quickly and accurately, catching editing issues before delivery.

A typical shift may involve reviewing 100–200+ photos, so speed, focus, and attention to detail are extremely important.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys structured work, visual detail, and organized systems.

Compensation: $4–$8 USD/hour

Hours: 10–20 hours per week

Preferred schedule: Morning EST or CST



Your Main Responsibility (Quality Control)



This is the most important part of the role.



You will:

• Review 100+ real estate photos per shift

• Check for editing issues such as:

exposure problems

color balance issues

crooked vertical lines

cropping mistakes



HDR blending errors



object removal mistakes (trash cans, cords, etc.)

• Ensure photo order and folder structure are correct

• Confirm files are ready for delivery to clients

• Flag issues to the editing team when something needs fixing



You must be able to move through large batches of photos efficiently without missing mistakes.



Additional Responsibilities

File Organization

• Maintain organized Google Drive folders

• Upload and deliver final media



Instagram Outreach

• Send outreach messages to potential clients

• Track conversations and follow-ups



QC and media delivery are the core responsibilities, outreach is secondary.

Required Skills

Candidates must have real photo editing experience, specifically:

• Adobe Lightroom

• Adobe Photoshop



Important:

Canva experience does NOT count as Photoshop experience for this role.

You do not need to be a full editor, but you must be able to recognize when an image looks incorrect.

You should understand:



• exposure issues

• color balance

• vertical line correction

• cropping problems

• HDR blending issues



Major Bonus Experience

Experience with real estate media workflows is a major advantage.



Examples include:

• HDPhotoHub

• Spiro

• AutoHDR

• Real estate media delivery platforms

• HDR editing workflows



Candidates with these skills usually ramp up much faster.



Ideal Candidate Background



The best candidates often come from:

• Photo editors

• Real estate media virtual assistants

• Real estate marketing assistants

• Photo retouchers

• Post-production assistants



Traits We Look For



You are likely a great fit if you are:

• Extremely detail oriented

• Comfortable reviewing large batches of images quickly

• Organized and process-driven

• Able to work independently after training

• Reliable and consistent with your schedule

• Comfortable communicating when issues arise



Non-Negotiables

• Availability: 10–20 hours per week

• Morning availability (EST/CST preferred)

• Reliable internet connection (large files involved)

• Clear written English

• Photoshop and Lightroom familiarity

• Ownership mindset



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



A brief introduction about your experience with Photoshop and Lightroom



Your internet speed



Links to any photo editing work or portfolio



Your availability (days and hours)



To confirm you read this entire job post, please include the phrase:

“I care about details.”

at the top of your application.

Applications that do not include this phrase will not be considered.

title: Experienced DM Appointment Setter for Established Coaching Business
description:
Are you a proven appointment setter who turns warm conversations into booked calls? Read on.



I'm a UK-based Career Coach running a growing online coaching community and programme. I have an established, engaged audience of thousands of followers that are ready to be outreached to.



This is not a cold outreach role. The audience already exists. Your job is to start and manage natural conversations with warm leads, qualify them, and move the right people into booked calls for our coaching programmes.



The role:



You'll be setting appointments through DMs (primarily LinkedIn), having genuine, natural-sounding conversations with people who already know my content. You'll qualify leads against clear criteria, book qualified prospects into my calendar, and keep every conversation tracked and followed up. Nobody falls through the cracks on your watch. Attention to detail is important as it's vital you follow through on every lead and never leave anyone without following through.



Your daily responsibilities:



- Send a daily report detailing conversations started, follow-ups sent, leads qualified, and appointments booked

- Manage DM conversations with warm leads: info-gather, build rapport, qualify against our criteria, and book qualified prospects into the calendar

- Follow up consistently with every open conversation using a structured follow-up system (you'll help build and refine this)

- Track all conversations, pipeline stages, and outcomes in our tracking sheet or CRM

- Create and continually refine SOPs for the setting process based on what you see working against our KPIs and OKRs



To qualify for this position, you will need proven experience in the following:



- Appointment setting in the DMs for an online coach, course creator, or agency (this is essential, you must have done this exact role before)

- Lead qualification: knowing how to spot a right-fit prospect and how to gracefully filter out the rest

- Excellent written English: your messages must sound natural, warm, and human, never scripted or robotic



What will really help you stand out:



- You come with your own ideas. You've seen what works in DM setting and you proactively suggest improvements

- You've worked to KPIs and OKRs before and can talk specifically about the numbers you hit

- Experience with CRM or pipeline tracking tools

- Familiarity with LinkedIn as a platform



We're building something long-term, so it's really important that you are:



- Detail-obsessed: you remember what people told you three conversations ago

- Consistent: you show up every single day and do the work without needing to be chased

- Resilient: you don't give up after one reply goes quiet, you follow up

- Observant with a great memory: you pick up on the small things people share and use them to build genuine rapport

- Positive, dedicated, and loyal

- Coachable: you take direction well, you're open to feedback, and you're always learning



Work schedule:



This is a part-time position to start, with the goal of hiring full-time for the right candidate.

UK/US timezone overlap is helpful but not required for all tasks.



Salary:



$400/month for part-time work (20 hours a week), with salary reviewed when the role moves to full-time. This is a base salary role only.



This role has genuine room to grow to full-time depending on your capability. You'll be working directly with me, the founder, and as the business grows, this role can grow with it.



How to apply:



When applying, put "I set the standard" in the subject heading.



In your application, please answer these questions:



1. Describe your previous appointment setting experience: who did you set for, what was the offer, and what were your numbers (conversations per day, booking rate, show rate)?

2. A warm lead has been chatting with you in the DMs about their career frustrations. Write the exact messages you would send to find out, in a soft and natural way, whether they earn above a specific income threshold, without it sounding blunt, harsh, or transactional

3. Describe your follow-up process when a lead goes quiet after showing initial interest

4. What is one improvement you made to a setting process in a previous role, and what result did it drive?



I look forward to hearing from you.

title: Dating App Assistant
description:
Personal Dating App Manager (Ghostwriter–Operator)





I'm hiring someone to run the day-to-day of my dating profiles. You're the engine behind the scenes: curating matches, opening conversations, keeping promising ones warm, and getting the good ones to a scheduled date. I handle the actual dates — you handle everything up to them.



This is fast AI-assisted drafting with light judgment, not pure copy-paste. You'll use tools to generate options quickly, but you read the thread and pick or adjust so it lands like a real person. The difference between a date and a dead conversation is usually one good reply at the unexpected 
nt — that's the skill I'm hiring for.



Apps you'd manage: [Hinge / Bumble / Tinder / etc.]

Goal: [be specific — e.g. "consistent, quality first dates with people I'd actually click with"]





What you'll do





Review and curate matches against a preferences brief I'll give you

Write openers and carry conversations in my voice

Keep 
ntum: timely replies, good questions, knowing when to ask someone out

Handle the "message three" save — when someone says something the script didn't anticipate, you keep it alive

Flag standout matches to me before any date is set

Maintain a clean log of who's who so threads never cross

Suggest tweaks to my photos and bio over time based on what's landing

Edit and prep my profile photos — light retouching, cropping, ordering, and basic cleanup so the profile always looks its best (no heavy/deceptive editing; the photos still have to look like me)







Tools & Workflow



You'll operate a defined stack so the work is fast and consistent. I'll provide access and a voice brief.





Drafting — YourMove AI (default engine for openers and replies). [Swap/secondary: SmoothRizz if we prioritize voice-consistency.]

Match tracking — Wingman (AI Dating Coach app): a profile per person so we track what's been said and what's worked, and never cross threads. Also our photo/bio optimizer.

Delivery — the actual apps, by hand. You log in and type inside [Hinge/Bumble/Tinder]. No automation or auto-senders — those get accounts banned. [Optional: Keys AI keyboard to speed up in-app typing, on the dedicated device only.]

Access — 1Password (or Bitwarden): you get login access without raw credentials; I can revoke instantly.

Brief & coordination — shared Notion doc: my voice, preferences, and standing rules live here.

Photo editing — [Lightroom Mobile / Snapseed / Canva / TouchRetouch]: for cropping, light retouching, ordering, and cleanup. Use whichever you're fluent in; just keep edits natural.





The rhythm: read the thread ? generate options ? pick the one that fits and tweak it to sound like me ? send ? log anything worth remembering. Seconds of judgment per message, not minutes of writing.





Who I'm looking for





A genuinely strong, natural writer with range — funny, warm, or sharp depending on the person

High emotional intelligence and a good read on subtext

Comfortable using AI tools to draft fast and the judgment to know when a suggestion is off

Competent with basic photo editing — cropping, light retouching, and selecting the strongest shots

Discreet and trustworthy — this is my actual dating life

Responsive during [active hours]

Bonus: you've done this kind of work before, or you're just unusually good at texting







Confidentiality



You'll have access to my accounts and personal conversations. A basic confidentiality agreement is part of the role — non-negotiable, and I'll provide it before any account access.





How to apply — the screening



I'm using a few short steps instead of a résumé, because the work is the audition.



Step 1 — Quick intro + read-the-brief check (5 min).

A short note answering: why does this kind of work appeal to you? Then, so I know you actually read instructions before acting:





Start your message with the word "Banana."

Keep the whole note under 100 words.

End with one line confirming you're comfortable signing a confidentiality agreement.





No cover letter — keep it human. (If you skip any of the three, I'll assume the instruction-following part of the job isn't a fit, and won't move forward. This is the filter, not a formality.)



Step 2 — Work sample (writing + photo).

I'll send a mock match profile and one sample photo. You'll:





Write the opener you'd send them.

Rewrite this bland bio to make it pull: "[insert a boring sample bio]"

Do a quick, natural edit of the sample photo (crop + light cleanup) and send it back — show me you can make a shot look its best without making it look fake.





Step 3 — The message-three save (the real filter).

I'll give you a conversation that's gone cold, or a match who said something slightly off or unexpected. Show me how you'd recover or respond. This tells me more than anything else.



Step 4 — Paid trial.

Top candidates do a [1–2 week] paid trial on a live account, with me reviewing before anything sends. If it clicks, we make it ongoing.



To start: reply with Step 1 and I'll send the Step 2 brief.





Notes for me before posting: lock the rate and hours (vague pay attracts vague applicants — even a range sharpens the pool a lot), confirm which apps I'm listing, and run YourMove + Wingman through their free trials on my real threads first so I know the stack actually works before handing it off.

# Real Estate Photo Editor & Quality Control Specialist

We are a real estate media company that creates photography, drone content, and marketing materials for real estate agents. * Look for editing mistakes or missing corrections.

* Ensure the gallery meets company standards.

* Confirm files are organised correctly and ready for delivery.

* Experience editing real estate photos.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

* Good internet connection and computer for photo editing.

* Good communication skills in English.

* Experience editing drone photos.

* Experience working with real estate photographers or agencies.

* Experience using AI editing tools.

You have a good eye for detail and enjoy producing high-quality work. You can follow instructions, stay organised, and consistently deliver professional results on time.

series: 30–40 minute episodes plus vertical Shorts. This is cinematic

storytelling, not ad content. Episode One is finished; a promo campaign

and Episode Two are shot-listed and ready to produce now.

the reference images, the duration, and how each clip connects to the

next. You bring the craftsmanship — generation, judgment, consistency,

and assembly.

  credits) from my prompt documents

  swap, clips must chain correctly (I provide the start-frame workflow)

  audio; regenerate smart

  synced dialogue and burned captions on Shorts

- If a scene doesn't make sense or a generation won't match the

  instructions, flag it to me — never quietly improvise

- Real experience with Seedance 2.0 or equivalent text-to-video tools

  (Kling, Veo, Runway) and able to master Seedance fast

experience, and staying current on new AI video tools — the field moves

fast, and I'd love to hear what's rising from you first.

- Shorts: $17 per finished Short (30–60 seconds — generated to spec,

  QC'd, assembled, captioned, ready for my final pass)

  prop swaps, or broken continuity are included — that's what

  "finished" means.

well and Episode Two is waiting; do that well and this becomes a

full-time hourly position as the show grows.

trial either way.

title: Organic Account Video Editor
description:
Here's the full job description with the tiered pay structure, a clear path to the money, and vision talk woven in to get strong applicants excited.



Organic Account Video Editor — AI Influencer Content (TikTok / IG Reels / YouTube Shorts)

We're a fast-growing health & wellness brand scaling our organic social presence hard — and we're looking for fast, consistent short-form editors to ride the wave with us. This is a systemized, high-volume role built on a simple truth: we already know what goes viral, because we're modeling proven winning accounts. Your job is to replicate what works, at speed, with our own AI influencer twist — and get paid more the bigger you help us grow.

You won't be guessing what to make. We hand you the reference accounts. You recreate the videos, swap in our AI character, and post consistently.

The process (per video):



Pull a video from our library of viral reference accounts and reuse the exact script/structure that's already proven to work

Recreate the video closely — screenshot the reference, drop it into our AI tools with the script, and rebuild it

Replace the on-screen talent with our AI influencer (one consistent character per account)

Caption, polish, and publish



We have an automation system on the way that will make this even faster. For now it's a manual, repeatable process — so we need someone reliable who can hit volume without cutting corners.

The daily target:



3 accounts, 5 videos per account = 15 videos per day

Each account keeps one consistent AI character for brand continuity

Consistency and turnaround win here — the formula is already provided



The opportunity (read this part carefully):

Accounts running this exact system are pulling 10M+ organic views in 30 days. That's not a typo. When you're posting proven content consistently across multiple accounts, the views compound fast — and every one of those views is a potential sale flowing through your affiliate link.

This is a genuine ground-floor opportunity. Get in now, master the system while it's manual, and you'll be the go-to operator when we roll out automation and scale to dozens of accounts. The editors who show up, stay consistent, and take this seriously are going to grow with the brand — not just edit for it.

Pay structure — base + affiliate commission (real path to $1,000+/week):



Onboarding (first 30 days): $500/mo base + affiliate commission on every sale from your content

Established: Base increases once you're consistently hitting 15/day and landing your first viral videos

Top performer: Highest base tier + commission for editors driving consistent viral hits and sales

Your affiliate link is your uncapped upside. The more your videos convert, the more you earn — on top of base. Consistent editors are realistically building toward $1,000+/week in the next 30–60 days as their accounts take off.



How you get there:

Week 1–2 you learn the system and lock in your daily volume. Weeks 3–4 your accounts start gaining traction and the first videos pop. By day 30–60, with consistent output, your accounts are compounding views, your commission is climbing, and your base steps up with your results. Show up daily, follow the system, and the numbers take care of themselves.

What we're looking for:



Fast, dependable editor who can hit daily volume without dropping quality

Comfortable working from references and following a proven system

Solid with CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar, plus willingness to learn our AI toolset

Sharp eye for matching pacing, captions, hooks, and sound to the original

Reliable communicator who shows up every day — this is a consistency game



How to apply:

Include (1) a link to your portfolio or 3–5 short-form videos you've edited, (2) which editing software you use, and (3) start your message with the word "REPLICATE" so we know you read this fully. Applications without a portfolio won't be considered.

title: Dental Marketing Specialist
description:
bout Us

We are a growing group of dental practices based in Ireland, operating multiple clinics with further expansion underway. We already work with a marketing company that runs much of our advertising — what we need now is someone in-house to own the daily picture: are leads coming in, are the campaigns actually performing, are those leads being contacted fast enough, and where are we leaking money or opportunities. You'll be the person who keeps everyone honest and the system tight.

What You'll Be Doing



Reviewing incoming leads every working day across all clinics and campaigns

Monitoring campaign performance (Meta & Google Ads) — spotting drops, spikes, attribution gaps, and wasted spend, and flagging them quickly

Tracking speed-to-lead: making sure every lead is contacted within target time, and surfacing the ones that slip through

Holding both the marketing company and the clinic teams accountable to the numbers — clear daily/weekly reporting on leads, cost-per-lead, contact rates, and conversions

Building and maintaining automations — lead routing, follow-up sequences, alerts for uncontacted leads, reminders, and reporting dashboards

Keeping lead data clean and consistent across the CRM and clinic systems

Liaising with our external marketing company — interrogating their reports rather than taking them at face value

Identifying patterns: which campaigns, locations, and treatments produce the best leads and the best conversions



What We Need From You



Demonstrable experience in the dental industry (or, at minimum, healthcare/clinical/multi-site services) — you understand the patient journey from enquiry to booked appointment

Solid working knowledge of Meta Ads and Google Ads — enough to read performance data critically, spot problems, and challenge an agency, even if you're not the one building campaigns from scratch

Hands-on experience setting up automations — [e.g. Zapier, Make, GoHighLevel, n8n — confirm your tools]

Strong analytical skills — comfortable living in spreadsheets, dashboards, and lead reports

A sharp eye for detail and a "follow the lead until it's resolved" mentality

Excellent written English and clear, proactive daily communication

Nice to Have



Experience with CRM and lead-management systems

Familiarity with dental practice management software (e.g. Aerona, Dentally)

GA4, call-tracking, and UTM/attribution experience

title: AI Content Creator / AI Video Editor (Daily Travel Videos)
description:
Please dont write unless you have read and followed the task. 



AI Content Creator / AI Video Editor (Daily Travel Videos)



About InfoAlanya



InfoAlanya is a travel platform and mobile app for tourists visiting Alanya, Turkey. We are a startup with the ambition of becoming the number one travel companion for everyone visiting Alanya.



Our mission is to make every holiday easier by giving visitors everything they need in one app. Through InfoAlanya, tourists can book airport transfers, discover tours and activities, find restaurants, beaches, attractions, hospitals, pharmacies, shopping, and much more.



We create daily content for TikTok, Instagram,
, and YouTube to inspire people to visit Alanya and help travelers get the most out of their holiday.



To grow our brand, we're looking for an exceptional AI Content Creator who can create highly realistic videos featuring me as the face of InfoAlanya.



About the Position



I'm looking for one exceptional AI Content Creator / AI Video Editor who can produce one high-quality, realistic travel video every day.



Initially, the project will last 2–3 weeks, with the possibility of a long-term collaboration if the quality is outstanding and we're a good match.



The Goal



The goal is to create videos that make it look and sound like I'm personally visiting different places and attractions around Alanya, even when I'm not physically there.



The videos must feel completely authentic. Viewers should genuinely believe that I visited the location, filmed the video myself, and naturally spoke every word.



You'll be working with my appearance, my voice, and my personality using the latest AI tools to create engaging travel content.



I will provide ideas, scripts, photos, videos, and voice recordings when needed. Your job is to transform them into realistic, high-quality videos for social media.



You Must Be Able To



• Create a highly realistic AI version of me that looks and behaves naturally.

• Clone my voice so it sounds authentic and human.

• Generate videos where it appears that I'm speaking completely new scripts.

• Place me naturally into different attractions, tours, restaurants, beaches, hotels, and other locations.

• Match facial expressions, body language, lip sync, lighting, colors, camera movement, reflections, shadows, and perspective.

• Blend AI footage so naturally that viewers cannot tell it's AI.

• Add subtitles, music, sound effects, and professional editing.

• Create engaging short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, and YouTube Shorts.



What I'm Looking For



• Expert in AI video editing and compositing.

• Able to create highly realistic, natural-looking videos.

• Strong motion tracking, masking, and compositing skills.

• Excellent color grading and lighting matching.

• Creative storyteller.

• Fast turnaround.

• Reliable communication.

• Able to deliver one high-quality video every day.



Required Skills



• AI Video Generation

• AI Voice Cloning

• Lip Sync

• Motion Tracking

• Compositing

• Masking

• Color Matching

• Video Editing

• Storytelling

• Sound Design



Experience with tools such as Runway, Veo, Kling, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar is a big advantage.



Test Task (Required)



Please create a 10–20 second sample video using the videos I have provided.



Requirements:



• Place me naturally into Green Canyon or another beautiful attraction in Alanya.

• Include my face and body naturally in the scene.

• Make it look like I'm genuinely there.

• If possible, also make it appear that I'm speaking naturally using my own cloned voice.

• Focus on realism rather than flashy effects.



The sample video will be the most important part of your application.



When Applying



Please include:



• Your sample video.

• Your portfolio.

• Which AI tools and editing software you use.

• Your expected daily, weekly, or monthly salary.

• How many hours per day you can work.

• When you can start.



Important



I'm not looking for someone who simply edits videos.



I'm looking for someone who can create a realistic digital version of me using AI.



The goal is that viewers genuinely believe I visited the location, filmed the content myself, and naturally spoke every word in the video.



If people suspect it's AI, the project has failed.



Quality is much more important than speed.



If your sample impresses me, this can become an ongoing collaboration with daily work.

title: Recruiting Manager - US Healthcare Staffing - Night Shift, Remote
description:
US-based healthcare direct-hire (permanent placement) recruiting firm is hiring a Recruiting Manager to own delivery and lead our small offshore recruiting team on US night shift. You run the funnel and the people — screen ? submit ? placement — not a req of your own. All clients and all placed candidates are US-based; this is an internal, fully remote, Philippines-based leadership seat.



You inherit a working machine: AI systems already do the sourcing, list-building, outreach, and daily worklists. Your job is the part machines can't do — screen candidates at volume, enforce quality, coach people, and convert pipeline into client submissions every single week. Company delivery standard: 15 screened submissions/week across the team.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN:

- Delivery: the screen-to-submit handoff at volume — every submission is recruiter-screened with license/credential verified BEFORE submit (hard rule, no exceptions). You own submit-to-interview ratio and time-to-fill.

- People: directly manage the team (Senior Recruiter + appointment setter(s), growing to a 3-5 person pod) — onboard, coach weekly with call reviews, performance-manage, and exit under-performers when needed.

- Cadence: run the daily standup against the AI-generated worklists (the day's screens, submits, and follow-ups are queued for you every morning — you make the team execute them).

- Reporting: a weekly KPI scorecard to the owner — submissions, interviews, placements, per-recruiter production — with honest numbers from the ATS, never narrative.



REQUIRED:

- 4+ years US healthcare staffing experience (agency side) — you've personally recruited US healthcare professionals (allied/imaging, nursing, or physician) for a staffing/recruiting firm, including direct-hire/permanent placement work.

- 1+ year leading a pod — you've directly managed recruiters and/or sourcers (not just mentored peers): assigned reqs, ran their numbers, coached them, and held them accountable.

- Metrics fluency — you can state, fro
mory, what a good recruiter produces per week (submissions, interview rate, placements) and what YOUR team produced. Vague answers end the process.

- Strong spoken English — you'll run standups, coach recruiters on live calls, and occasionally speak with US clients. There WILL be a recorded voice check and a live spoken interview.

- Can work the FIXED US night shift (9:00 PM-6:00 AM PHT, Mon-Fri) long-term with a reliable home setup (quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data).

- ATS fluency (Manatal or equivalent) + comfort working alongside AI sourcing/outreach systems.



COMPENSATION: $1,400-$1,800/month base by experience (night differential included) + monthly performance commission tied to team placements — the better your pod delivers, the more you earn; specifics discussed at offer. Paid via Wise, reliable and on time. Long-term seat with real authority: hiring input, performance management, and a direct line to the owner.



DO NOT APPLY IF: you have no US staffing/recruiting agency experience (PH-local or non-US recruiting only); your leadership experience is BPO customer service/collections/support — not recruiting; you've never directly managed recruiters or can't quantify your team's numbers; your US experience is IT-contract-only with no healthcare; or you cannot commit to the fixed US night shift long-term.



WHY US: you're not recruiter #12 at a mega-agency — you're the delivery leader of a lean, AI-first US healthcare firm where your team's placements are visible in revenue the same month. Clear path: Recruiting Manager ? Head of Delivery as the pod grows.



TO APPLY, ANSWER ALL SIX (applications missing any of these will not be reviewed):

1. List your US healthcare staffing experience: agency name(s), years at each, which US healthcare roles you recruited (imaging/allied, nursing, physician, other), and the split of direct-hire/permanent vs travel/contract work.

2. Describe the team you led: how many recruiters/sourcers reported to YOU directly, for how long, and what happened to under-performers (give one real example — what you did, week by week, and the outcome).

3. Your team's numbers in one recent normal month: submissions per recruiter/week, submit-to-interview %, placements that month. Then YOUR OWN personal numbers when you carried a desk. (Real numbers — we verify against your story on the call.)

4. Include a LINK to a 60-90 second voice recording: explain how you would run a 5-person US-healthcare recruiting desk to 15 screened submissions/week — your daily standup, the 3 KPIs you'd track, and how you'd enforce screen quality — and state your own production numbers out loud. (This is the single most important part of your application.)

5. Can you commit to a FIXED US night shift (9:00 PM-6:00 AM PHT), Mon-Fri, long-term? (Yes/No + any constraint) Home setup: internet speed, headset, quiet space, backup power/internet? Y/N each.

6. Current/most-recent monthly pay (PHP or USD) and earliest start date.

CallBrixa is an AI receptionist service for HVAC companies in the United States. Our AI helps HVAC businesses answer missed calls, qualify leads, collect customer details, identify urgent HVAC situations, and send short call summaries to the business owner.



This is not just a regular cold calling position. We need someone who can make calls personally, manage other callers, help hire new callers, review reports, improve scripts, train the team, and give honest feedback.



At the beginning, you will manage yourself and 2 cold callers. As the team grows, you may help us hire and manage more callers.



ABOUT CALLBRIXA



CallBrixa helps HVAC companies avoid losing customers from missed calls.



Many HVAC business owners miss customer calls when they are busy, driving, working on a job, closed, or receiving calls after hours. CallBrixa answers those calls with an AI receptionist.



The AI can:

- Answer calls 24/7

- Ask what service the customer needs

- Collect the customer’s name, phone number, address, issue details, and urgency

- Identify urgent HVAC situations such as no heating, no cooling, or emergency repairs

- Send a short call summary to the business owner

- Give business owners a demo number they can call to test how the AI receptionist works



We are also adding more features soon, including Google Calendar scheduling. This will allow the AI assistant to check available appointment times, suggest visit times to the customer, and book the appointment if the customer agrees.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Cold Calling



- Call HVAC businesses in the United States

- Speak with owners or managers

- Explain CallBrixa in a simple and professional way

- Ask if they miss calls when they are busy, driving, on a job, closed, or after hours

- Offer them an easy way to test the AI receptionist by calling our demo number

- Follow the call script, but also improve it based on real conversations

- Record every call result in the reporting file



2. Team Management



- Manage 2 cold callers at the beginning

- Check their daily reports

- Make sure they are calling properly

- Review their performance

- Help them improve their calls

- Help them understand the script and offer

- Make sure they record results correctly



3. Hiring and Training



- Help interview new cold callers

- Review candidates

- Give feedback about who looks strong or weak

- Help onboard new callers

- Train new callers using our script and reporting system

- Recommend who should stay, who needs more training, and who should be replaced



4. Reporting



You will send a daily summary report to the owner, including:



- How many calls were made

- How many people answered

- How many owners or managers were reached

- How many people were interested

- How many potential customers were generated

- What problems happened during the day

- What should be improved



5. Script Improvement



- Improve the cold call script based on real conversations

- Share common objections from business owners

- Suggest better ways to explain CallBrixa

- Help make the team better over time



WORK SCHEDULE



- 4–6 hours per day

- Monday to Friday

- US business hours



Expected time split:



- Around 4 hours per day making your own cold calls

- Around 1–2 hours per day managing callers, checking reports, hiring, training, and improving scripts



This can become a long-term position if performance is good.



COMPENSATION



Team Lead:



- $6/hour

- 4–6 hours per day

- Paid trial period first

- Long-term position available if performance is good



Bonuses:



- $25 for each first paid customer generated from your own calls

- $15 for each first paid customer generated by your tea
mbers



Regular cold callers on your team will usually be paid:



- $4/hour

- $25 bonus for each first paid customer



BONUS RULES



A paid customer bonus is paid only after the customer’s first monthly payment is successfully received and not refunded within 7 days.



The customer must be a real HVAC or related home service business.



The customer cannot be personally connected to the caller.



The lead source must be clearly recorded in the reporting file.



We do not pay second-month bonuses at this stage.



We do not pay bonuses for fake leads, personal contacts, duplicate businesses, or customers who request a refund within 7 days.



REQUIREMENTS



- Experience in cold calling, appointment setting, outbound sales, or lead generation

- Experience managing or training other callers is strongly preferred

- Good spoken English

- Comfortable speaking with US business owners

- Organized and honest with reports

- Able to follow and improve scripts

- Able to manage a small remote team

- Able to work during US business hours

- Able to give honest feedback about other callers

- Able to help hire and train new callers

- Experience with HVAC, home services, SaaS, or B2B sales is a plus



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who can lead by example.



This means you should be able to make calls yourself, not only manage others.



You should be comfortable testing scripts, improving the pitch, helping other callers, and sending clear daily reports.



We want someone responsible, honest, organized, and proactive.



If someone on the team is not performing well, we expect you to explain why and recommend what should be done.



You will not make final hiring or firing decisions alone. You will review performance, explain your recommendation, and the final decision will be approved by the owner.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short summary of your cold calling experience

2. Your experience managing or training other callers

3. A short voice recording introducing yourself

4. Your availability during US business hours

5. Your expected weekly schedule

6. Why you think you would be a good fit for this Team Lead role

title: Full Cycle Bookkeeper - Experienced 5 yr +
description:
Read this entire posting before applying. If you skip to the apply button, you will be rejected automatically.

I am done wasting time and money on VAs who overpromise and underdeliver. This posting is intentionally blunt so only qualified, serious candidates apply. If you do not meet ALL of the requirements below, do not apply — you will not be considered, and applications that ignore this will be deleted without a response.

Non-Negotiable Requirements — ALL of these are deal-breakers if not met:



1 -Speak and write English clearly. If you have a thick accent or are not fluent in written and spoken English, do not apply. This is an immediate disqualifier.

2 - Be an actual, hands-on expert in bookkeeping, payroll, and HR administration. I use QuickBooks Online, Cin7 Core for inventory/COGS, MakersHub for AP, and Paylocity for payroll. If you claim experience with these tools and then have to Google how to do basic tasks once hired, this is an immediate disqualifier. You will be tested before hire — see below.

3 - Explain things simply. I am not an accountant. If I ask you a question and you can't break it down in plain language I understand right away, do not apply. I need someone who translates the technical into the simple, not someone who talks over my head.

4 - Follow instructions exactly. I have had VAs guess at what I wanted, get "creative," do work I never asked for, and then expect to be paid for it. This happens ONCE and we're done. I am open to your suggestions on better ways to do things — but only with my approval before you act. Suggest, don't assume.

5 - Do not pad your hours. I know roughly how long tasks take, and I am generous about it. If I see 15-minute tasks billed as multi-hour tasks, my generosity disappears immediately and so does the job.

6 - Show up on time, every time. I understand life happens — tell me in advance and I will be understanding. Chronic lateness or last-minute excuses (storms, internet outages, etc., without advance notice) will end this immediately. One strike.

7 - We pay via Payoneer ONLY. No exceptions. If you don't have a Payoneer account or can't set one up, do not apply. This is nonnegotiable — no PayPal, no Wise, no bank transfer, no other method.

8 - We track time using Timeproof. Mandatory, no exceptions. If you are not willing to use Timeproof for every hour billed, do not apply. This is not up for discussion.

9 - Meetings are professional — no children visible or audible on camera. These are leadership meetings. My team does not bring kids into the office, and I expect the same from you. Have children asleep, at school, or with another caregiver during our scheduled meeting times. If a child is on camera or heard in the background, the meeting will end.

10 - If I call you during paid hours, you answer. Period. No exceptions, no "I saw it but was busy." If you're on the clock, you're reachable.



What You'll Be Doing:



Full-cycle bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online — transaction coding, reconciliations, AP/AR

Inventory and COGS tracking and reconciliation in Cin7 Core

Vendor bill capture, approval routing, and payment processing through MakersHub or QBO

Payroll support and coordination through Paylocity

HR administrative support — onboarding documentation, recordkeeping, basic compliance tasks

Monthly financial reporting to ownership



Application Instructions — Read Carefully:



To prove you read this far, start your application with the word LEDGER in the subject line. Applications without it will not be opened.

Confirm in your application that you have a Payoneer account, are willing to use Timeproof for every hour worked, can keep meetings child-free, and will answer calls during paid hours. If you don't confirm all four, your application will be skipped.

Include your specific hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online, Cin7 Core, MakersHub, and Paylocity — not "familiar with," actual experience.

Include your available start date and your hourly rate expectation.

Be prepared to complete a short paid skills test before any offer is made.



This is a long-term, part-time position for the right person, with room to grow. If you meet every requirement above and can prove it, I want to hear from you. If you don't, please save us both the time.

description:

About Us



ArcaTech creates cinematic video home tours and social media content for real estate agents in Las Vegas. Reframe and re-edit 16:9 footage into clean, dynamic 9:16 vertical cuts

Build real estate montages with smooth, intentional room-to-room transitions that make the flow of a home feel natural and immersive

Execute day-to-night transitions and timelapses that feel seamless, not gimmicky

Create "assemble/disassemble" effects — homes that build themselves piece by piece or fold away — as a signature visual style

Experience building "build/disassemble" or similar stylized transition effects (Premiere, After Effects, or similar)

An eye for salvaging imperfect footage — shaky handheld, inconsistent lighting, awkward angles — and still producing a clean final product

Fast, clear communication and reliable delivery timelines

Familiarity with real estate marketing content is a strong plus





Tools We Use



Sony A7SIII footage delivered raw. You're welcome to use your preferred editing suite (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, etc.) as long as the output quality speaks for itself.



To Apply

title: Facebook Reel Editor — UK Talent Content
description:
The Role

We're looking for a fast, reliable video editor to join a small team producing monetised
 content for high-profile UK reality TV talent. This is a freelance, remote role with consistent weekly volume and the potential to scale as we onboard additional talent pages.

You'll be cutting raw footage — to-camera clips, voice notes, behind-the-scenes material, archive content — into 1–3 minute
 reels optimised for watch-time, comments and shares as well as monetisation. The creative direction, hooks, and structures will be provided to you in detailed build packages. Your job is to execute them quickly and cleanly. Your creative direction and adjustments to ensure virality are esential.



What You'll Be Editing

All content is for
 pages with a predominantly female UK and Australian audience aged 30–40. These are women who are mums, who follow reality TV, who engage with honest parenting content, relationship real talk, body image, postpartum life, and unfiltered personal storytelling. Understanding this audience is essential — the edit style, pacing, music choices, and text overlays all need to feel right for this demographic. Nothing overly polished or influencer-glossy. Nothing that feels like it was made for a 22-year-old on TikTok.



The content that performs best on these pages is raw, emotionally honest, and real. Think: a new mum talking candidly about her c-section recovery, not a wellness brand doing a transition reel. The editing should enhance the authenticity, not cover it up.



Mothers with young children are particularly encouraged to apply. Much of the content centres on the reality of early motherhood — breastfeeding struggles, postpartum recovery, sleep deprivation, the emotional rollercoaster of having a newborn — and an editor who has lived that experience will instinctively understand where the emotional beats land in a way that's very difficult to brief for.



Deliverables

•  1–3 minute
 reels, edited from raw footage and/or archive clips

•  Each reel follows a provided build package: timestamped structure, hook, voiceover notes, on-screen text, shot-by-shot timeline

•  Clean first frames (no black screens, no mid-sentence starts — the thumbnail is the first frame)

•  Music/sound selection appropriate for UK mum audience — emotionally resonant, not trend-chasing

•  Exported in
-optimised format (9:16 or 4:5 depending on content type, high resolution)

•  Estimated volume: 10–15 reels per week across one page initially, scaling to multiple pages





What We Need From You

•  Strong understanding of the UK market and UK cultural references — Geordie Shore, ITV reality, UK parenting culture, British humour and tone. If you don't know what a Greggs sausage roll is, this probably isn't the right fit.

•  Experience editing content for women and/or mums — you understand pacing that holds attention for this demographic, not just Gen Z scroll speed

•  An instinct for emotional storytelling — knowing where to cut, where to let a moment breathe, where to drop in text that lands

•  Fast turnaround — we work in weekly batches and need reliability above all

•  Comfortable working from detailed briefs and build packages rather than freestyling — the creative direction is set, you're executing it

•  Basic understanding of
 monetisation and watch-time mechanics (we'll brief you fully, but awareness helps)

•  Responsive communication, ideally on WhatsApp or Slack

•  Familiarity with the talent we work with is a genuine bonus — if you already follow or watch them, you'll have a natural feel for the content and the audience





What You Don't Need

•  You don't need to be UK-based, but you do need to understand the UK audience and cultural context

•  You don't need to write captions, titles, or thumbnails — those are handled separately

•  You don't need high-end motion graphics skills — this is about authentic, emotionally engaging cuts, not flashy production





Terms

•  Freelance / contract basis

•  Paid per reel or monthly retainer depending on volume (discuss at application) potential for full time role.

•  Trial period: 5 reels in the first week to assess quality, speed, and reliability

•  Potential to scale significantly as additional talent pages come online



To Apply

Send a short message with:

•  2–3 examples of reels or short-form videos you've edited (ideally for a female/mum audience or UK talent — but any strong emotional storytelling work is relevant)

•  Your typical turnaround time for a 2–3 minute reel from provided footage (or that which you source from Instagram/TT)•  Your rate (per reel or monthly)

•  A one-line summary of why you'd be a good fit for this specific audience

•  Name a piece of UK reality TV content you've watched or followed recently — this helps us gauge your familiarity with the market



No agencies. No generic applications. If your portfolio is all corporate explainers and product ads, this isn't the role.

title: Senior Executive Assistant / Client Operations - US IT Services Firm (MSP experience preferred)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION (paste below into description box):



ABOUT US



We are an established, growing US-based managed IT services provider (MSP) serving businesses in regulated industries. Small team, high standards, long-term client relationships. This role works directly with the owner as his right hand.



WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT



This is not a task-list VA position. The owner will hand you entire workstreams in working sessions. For example: "own the renewal process for all of our client agreements" or "roll out updated employment agreements to our staff." Your job is to ask sharp questions, build the process, execute to 80-90% completion, and return with focused, decision-ready questions: "here is my thinking, do you want direction A or direction B?"



You will draft client-facing communication that requires care and nuance, keep billing and renewal cycles running on time, handle procurement and vendor follow-ups, and close every loop without being reminded.



You will also work alongside serious AI tooling (Claude) every day. No prior AI experience is required, but you must be the kind of person who picks up new tools quickly and gets excited about what they can do. Here, AI handles much of the drafting and computation; your judgment directs it. One sharp person in this role does the work of three.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Client agreement renewals: the calendar, updated agreements, outreach, and follow-through (the owner handles only the largest strategic conversations)

- Client operations communication: order updates, pricing-change notes, and day-to-day client
s that need nuance and warmth

- Billing administration: monthly license invoicing, catching unbilled work, keeping invoices aligned with agreements

- Procurement: hardware quotes and orders, vendor follow-ups, license purchasing

- Internal projects: for example, rolling out NDAs and updated employment agreements via DocuSign, from research to signed

- Owner support: calendar, travel, payment deadlines, the details that keep a business running smoothly



YOU ARE PROBABLY A FIT IF



- You have 4+ years as an EA, operations coordinator, service coordinator, or account manager

- You have MSP or IT services experience (strongly preferred); you know what a PSA is, and ConnectWise, Autotask, or HaloPSA experience is a significant plus

- Your written English is excellent; you can take three tangled facts and turn them into one clear, warm, professional client note

- You have BUILT processes, not just followed them, and can tell us about one

- You flag things that look wrong instead of guessing

- You are comfortable being handed ambiguity and coming back with a plan

- You are excited about AI and learn new tools quickly

- You have reliable power and internet with a tested backup plan (we will ask)

- You can overlap US Mountain Time mornings by at least 4 hours (roughly 9pm-1am PH time, negotiable)



COMPENSATION AND SETUP



- $1,300-$1,700/month USD full-time, depending on experience, deliberately above typical market, because we are hiring judgment, not just hands

- Compensation review at 90 days, with real raise potential for demonstrated ownership

- Long-term role with growing responsibility; we are hiring for years, not months

- 13th month honored; paid PH holidays negotiable

- Shortlisted candidates complete a PAID work sample (about 2.5 hours, $40); we respect your time



HOW TO APPLY



Put the word COMPASS as the first word of your application subject line. Applications without it will not be read. This is our attention-to-detail filter; this role lives and dies on details.



Send a short note about yourself (not a template, we can tell) plus your CV, and complete these four items:



1. Describe a process you built from scratch at a previous job. What was messy before, and what did you create?



2. Tell us about a billing, order, or scheduling discrepancy you caught that nobody asked you to look for. What happened?



3. Scenario: a client's hardware order changed. Prices rose industry-wide since the original quote. The first machine chosen was somewhat over-spec for their needs. The replacement now being quoted is both a better fit AND a better machine, at a strong price given the market. Write the 3-6 sentence
 to the client.



4. Include a short video (60-90 seconds, Loom or similar). No script, no slides, just talk: pick the most complex thing you manage in your current or most recent role, and explain it to us the way you would to a new colleague on their first day. We want to hear how you communicate when you have not rehearsed.

title: Remote Senior Nonprofit Bookkeeper
description:
About Us

We are a USA-based accounting and advisory firm dedicated exclusively to serving nonprofit organizations and mental health practices. We manage the complete accounting cycle for a portfolio of nonprofit clients simultaneously, delivering accurate, timely, and audit-ready financial records. Our clients trust us with the financial foundation of their missions. Every tea
mber we bring on is expected to perform at a professional level from day one, follow our documented systems, and take genuine ownership of their client portfolio.



About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented Senior Bookkeeper to join our team. In this role, you will oversee comprehensive bookkeeping functions, ensuring accuracy and compliance across all financial records for a portfolio of nonprofit clients. You will work within our established systems and be held to firm-wide standards of accuracy and deadlines from day one.



This is not an entry-level role. You are expected to arrive with a fully developed competency in nonprofit accounting and the professional judgment to apply it independently across multiple clients in a remote environment.



Responsibilities

- Record and classify all transactions on an accrual basis with proper account coding, class tracking, and fund designation.

- Manage and maintain the general ledger in accordance with GAAP.

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable: enter vendor bills, process payments, record invoices, and apply receipts accurately.

- Prepare and post all month-end journal entries, including accruals, prepaid amortization, depreciation, and deferred revenue schedules.

- Conduct balance sheet reconciliation and review financial statements for discrepancies or errors.

- Record payroll allocation entries across cost centers, grants, and functional expense categories.

- Track restricted grants, donor contributions, and program expenses in compliance with nonprofit accounting standards.

- Produce and deliver month-end financial statements for management review.

- Support the Form 990 and audit preparation process by maintaining clean, organized records and preparing schedules as requested.

- Maintain meticulous records of journal entries, account analyses, and audit documentation to ensure audit readiness.

- Utilize accounting software, including QuickBooks Online and Xero, to manage bookkeeping operations.

- Identify opportunities to automate financial processes and increase efficiency.

- Deliver clear, accurate financial reports for internal review, client communication, and external audits.



Qualifications

 - Minimum 5 years of nonprofit accounting experience with demonstrated ability to apply accrual accounting, fund accounting, net asset classifications under ASU
, grant tracking, and functional expense allocation independently and without supervision.

 - Demonstrated ability to apply ASC 606 and ASC 842 standards, specifically managing revenue recognition based on grant documents, funder restrictions, and milestones.

- Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously in an outsourced accounting firm or agency setting.

- Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO), Xero, Sage, and other financial management tools.

- Advanced proficiency in project and work management tools such as Asana, Gmail, Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, 
, Ramp, and similar platforms.

- Deep understanding of GAAP, double-entry bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, and general ledger reconciliation.

- Familiarity with governmental accounting practices and tax experience is highly desirable.

- Excellent knowledge of financial concepts, including account analysis, account reconciliation, debits and credits, journal entries, and balance sheet management.

- Ability to context-shift between multiple clients and thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment.

- Strong attention to detail and analytical skills to interpret complex financial data accurately.

- Effective written communication skills for financial reporting and client correspondence.

- High integrity, accountability, and respect for client confidentiality.

- Minimum 12 consecutive months of fully remote, self-directed work with independent deadline management.

- Problem-solving mentality with a proactive approach to process improvement and continuous learning.



Schedule and Compensation

- Commit to working a minimum of15 hours per week, with required availability from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM EST (8:00 PM to 3:00 AM PHT). 

- Hours are expected to increase to full-time as performance benchmarks are met and the client portfolio grows.



To Apply: To be considered for this position, your application must include the following, submitted together in a single
:

 - Your resume

 - A brief message describing your experience with nonprofit fund accounting and at least one outsourced or multi-client accounting environment you have supported

- The answer to the following question, included at the top of your message: "What is the net asset classification framework introduced under ASU
, and how does it differ from the previous two-category model?"

 - If you qualify for the next phase, you will be required to complete an accounting test and pass it with a 90% rate.



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be reviewed and will be automatically rejected.

title: QA Annotator – AI Voice Call Review (Healthtech, ~5–10 hrs/month)
description:

Edge cases get escalated to me (the founder) with short written notes – no live meetings, fully async.

- Excellent English comprehension, especially phone audio with accents and background noise

- ~5–10 hours/month, concentrated over a few days each refresh cycle (first month will be heavier – full data refresh)

- $7 USD/hr, paid monthly – modest hours, but stable ongoing work with a growing company

- Confidentiality agreement required (healthcare-adjacent data)

- Shortlisted candidates will complete a short **paid** trial batch of real calls before final hiring



**HOW TO APPLY – read carefully**



Applications that don't follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



1. Start your application with the word **MAPLE**.



2. Answer this scenario in 2–4 sentences:

title: Senior Product Fulfillment & Supplier Negotiation Specialist
description:
We are a fast-growing ecommerce store in the lighting and home decor space. We sell pendant lights, chandeliers, wall lights, ceiling fans, outdoor lighting, and decor products.



We are looking for an extremely detail-oriented Senior Product Fulfillment Specialist who can manage complex customer orders, communicate with multiple suppliers, negotiate the best price, verify that every order is correct, review QC photos/videos, and track every step in a spreadsheet.



This is not a simple “place orders” role. We need someone who can think, compare, question suppliers, catch mistakes before they happen, and protect the profit margin of the business.



Main Responsibilities



You will be responsible for managing product fulfillment from order confirmation through to delivery.



Your tasks will include:



-Review each customer order carefully before fulfillment.

-Confirm the correct product, size, color, finish, voltage, quantity, and variant.

-Compare supplier quotes in a spreadsheet before choosing the best option.

-Confirm that the supplier understands the exact order requirements before production/shipping.

-Request and review QC photos/videos before dispatch.

-Check for visible defects, wrong colors, incorrect dimensions, missing parts, poor packaging, or anything that could cause a customer complaint.

-Track every order in a detailed spreadsheet with supplier, cost, status, tracking number, ETA, QC status, notes, and issues.

-Follow up with suppliers daily when needed.

-Escalate problems quickly instead of waiting until they become bigger issues.

-Look for ways to reduce costs, prevent mistakes, and improve our fulfillment process.



This Role Is Perfect For Someone Who



-Has experience managing ecommerce orders at scale.

-Has worked with multiple suppliers, agents, factories, or sourcing teams.

-Is confident negotiating price and asking suppliers difficult questions.

-Is extremely vigilant with details.

-Is comfortable working inside spreadsheets every day.

-Can handle complex orders with multiple variants, custom requirements, and supplier options.

-Understands that one small mistake can cost the business hundreds or thousands of dollars.

-Takes ownership and does not need to be constantly reminded.



Requirements



You must have:



-Proven experience in ecommerce fulfillment, procurement, sourcing, dropshipping operations, or supplier management.

-Experience handling complex product orders, not just simple one-click fulfillment.

-Experience working with suppliers, factories, agents, or manufacturers.

-Strong spreadsheet skills using Google Sheets or Excel.

-Excellent written English.

-Extremely strong communication skills 

-Very strong attention to detail.

-Reporting skills once per week

-Ability to negotiate professionally with suppliers.

-Ability to follow SOPs while also thinking independently.

-Stable internet connection and reliable availability.



Experience in lighting, furniture, home decor, construction products, or high-ticket ecommerce is a major advantage.



Proof of Experience Required



In your application, please include:



-The previous companies or stores you have worked for.

-The type of products you fulfilled or sourced.

-Expected Salary 

-The average number of orders you handled per week or per month.

-Whether you worked with suppliers, factories, agents, or 3PLs.

-An example of a complex fulfillment problem you solved.

-An example of a time you saved money for a business by negotiating or comparing suppliers.

-Your experience with Google Sheets or Excel.

-Any screenshots, templates, SOPs, reports, or trackers you have created, with private information removed.





Applications without proof of relevant experience will not be considered.





Application Test Question



A customer orders 4 brass pendant lights for $2,000.



You receive these supplier options:



Supplier A: $160 per light, $280 shipping, ships in 4 days. However, the brass finish looks slightly different in their photos.



Supplier B: $190 per light, $220 shipping, ships in 10 days. They confirm the exact finish, correct size, correct voltage, and will send QC photos before shipping.



Supplier C: $145 per light, $330 shipping, ships tomorrow. However, the size is 5cm smaller than our product page and they cannot provide QC photos.



Which supplier would you choose and why?



In your answer, please include:



The total cost of each supplier.

The risks you see with each option.

The questions you would ask before placing the order.

The QC photos or proof you would request.

What details you would track in the spreadsheet.

An example of a similar situation you have handled before.



We are looking for someone who protects profit margin, catches mistakes, and does not simply choose the cheapest supplier.



RESPONSES ARE ALL AI PLAGIARISM-CHECKED. AI RESPONSES WILL BE FLAGGED AND APPLICATION WILL BE DELETED. 



Important Traits We Are Looking For:

Detail-obsessed

Honest

Organised

Strong negotiator

Good with spreadsheets

Calm under pressure

Able to catch mistakes early

Comfortable asking suppliers direct questions

Reliable with daily follow-up

Google Sheets

Gmail

Shopify

Supplier portals

WhatsApp / WeChat /

Tracking websites

Internal SOPs and order trackers



Experience with Shopify is REQUIRED 



Working Hours



This is a remote role. We are looking for someone who can work consistently and provide daily updates. 40 hours minimum per week. 



Please include your preferred working hours and time zone in your application.



How to Apply



To apply, please send:



A short introduction about your experience.

Your previous fulfillment, sourcing, or supplier management roles.

The scale of orders you have handled.

Your answer to the application test question above.
